scope: Read-only authored-source audit; no native orphan/ambiguity reproduction, no compiled P-OFLAG slot qualification, no API/fact/code consensus

findings.fact: PARSER only resets P-OADJ/P-ADJECTIVE/P-MERGED etc before its ordinary READ; it does not clear P-OFLAG there.
Missing noun/syntax orphan asks what to do, sets P-OFLAG true, returns false; main loop can invoke PARSER again at same READ.
Ambiguous noun WHICH-PRINT path calls ORPHAN and sets P-OFLAG true before returning false.
After next line is read, existing P-OFLAG triggers ORPHAN-MERGE; clearing happens inside merge, not before READ.
MAIN-LOOP invokes PARSER each iteration, so a failed parse can return to same READ while a clarification is pending.

conclusion: The observed ordinary parser READ resumePC26723 is not by itself an ordinary fresh-command certificate: authored orphan/ambiguity continuations reuse this parser READ. Pending request freshness + PC discriminator excluding YES? still needs qualified parser-context admission. P-OFLAG and associated continuation state are source candidates only, no guessed numeric slots or value predicates.
